title: VeldrixAI Policy Engine — Shadow on Dev Traffic (Phase 6)

panels.title: IMPACT GUARD — request-path dispatch hand-off latency (must stay ~0)
panels.description: THE metric that matters most: latency the out-of-band dispatch adds to the REQUEST PATH (gate check + add_task only; the worker runs after the response). p99 should sit in the sub-millisecond buckets. A rise here means the out-of-band promise is breaking — investigate before ramping.

panels.title: Sample % in effect
panels.description: The live ENGINE_SHADOW_SAMPLE_PCT. 0 = detached/un-ramped. Reconfigurable at request time (no restart).

panels.title: What the engine WOULD decide on dev traffic (by verb)
panels.description: The shadow-on-dev-traffic artifact: the distribution of decided actions the engine reaches on real requests, recorded enforced:false. This is what later seeds the prod enforce-mode conversation.

panels.title: Shadow dispatch outcomes (rate)
panels.description: Full accounting of every request's shadow opportunity: dispatched / skipped_kill_switch / skipped_unsampled / dropped_backpressure / dropped_dispatch / worker_exception / written / write_failed. Dropped work is never invisible.

panels.title: Dedicated worker pool — in-flight (saturation)
panels.description: In-flight requests on the DEDICATED shadow worker HTTP pool (isolated from the request-path pool). Proves the worker is not consuming request-path connections. If this pins at the pool ceiling, writes shed (see write_failed) — that is the isolation working, not a request-path problem. The peak series is the process high-water mark: saturation bursts are sub-second, so the instantaneous gauge alone can slip between 15s scrapes.

panels.title: Worker eval latency p50 / p95 / p99 (off the request path)
Dropped / failed / exception (the fault counters)
panels.description: Shed + failure accounting. Under deliberate fault injection (and real overload) these rise while the IMPACT GUARD stays ~0 — that combination is the proof package for prod promotion.

panels.title: Runtime backpressure shed (shared primitive)
panels.description: The Phase-2 runtime concurrency gate sheds rather than queues. The worker maps these to dropped_backpressure.
